description:
Pocket Folders Built for Branding and Organization

Fully customizable presentation folders with pockets are the perfect way to keep your documents organized and your brand looking professional. Choose from four size options, durable paper stocks, and add business card slots to make every folder as functional as it is impressive.

Our Recommended Presentation Folder Setup


Pocket Folder Size

9” x 12” – The Standard Choice This size is designed to fit standard letter-size documents, making it the go-to option for business presentations, marketing kits, and professional handouts. The 9” x 12” format provides ample room for your branding while keeping everything neatly organized.

Outside & Inside Printing (Including Pockets)

Make the most of your design by printing in full color inside and out. Showcase your logo and visuals on the outside for instant impact, then extend your branding to the inside panels and pockets for a cohesive look that leaves a lasting impression.

Additional Customization Options for Your Pocket Folders

Add practical features and flexible choices that make your pocket folders more professional, branded, and effective for every presentation.



Paper Options
Choose between sturdy 14 pt. and premium 16 pt. cardstock for the right balance of durability and feel. Each stock comes with finish options — Gloss for vibrant colors, Matte for a smooth, understated look, and High Gloss UV for extra shine and protection. These finishes ensure your folders don’t just carry documents but also reinforce your brand image.

Size Options
Select the best fit for your needs. The standard 9” x 12” folder is ideal for letter-size documents, while the 9” x 14.5” option accommodates legal-size paperwork. For compact handouts or smaller presentations, the 6” x 9” mini folder is a convenient, portable choice.

Business Card Slot
Give your folders an added professional touch with die-cut slots built into the pockets. Place a card on the left, right, or both pockets so clients can quickly find your contact details. It’s a simple addition that turns each folder into a complete branding package.

Flexible Quantities
Order exactly what you need, from small runs of 25 for boutique projects or team meetings to bulk orders of up to 10,000 for conferences, trade shows, or corporate rollouts. Fast turnaround times ensure you get the right amount, right when you need them.


Folder Printing FAQs

Q: Do you offer custom sizes?

We currently don’t offer custom sizes. However, we assure you that our standard pocket folders can fit various paper sizes.

Q: How many pockets are in the folder?

Our pocket folders have one pocket on the left and one pocket on the right.

Q: Can I print on both sides of the folder?

Yes, you can print your design on the inside as well as outside the folder.

Q: Are the business card slots customizable?

Yes, they are. You can have the business card slot on the left, right, or both sides of the inner pocket.

Q: Are the pocket folders pre-folded?

Yes, they are. You don’t need to fold the pocket folders yourself once they’re delivered.

Q: When can I expect my order?

Our printing turnaround is 1-4 business days. To get an estimate of your delivery date, click “Estimate Shipping & Delivery” under the product calculator.

Q: How do I customize the inside pockets of my branded presentation folders?

You can upload a design that extends into the inside panels and pockets. This allows you to include graphics, brand colors, or even messaging that gets revealed once the folder is opened.

Q: Do you offer mini pocket folder size?

Yes. In addition to standard 9” x 12” and legal 9” x 14.5” formats, you can order a compact 6” x 9” mini folder, ideal for smaller handouts or marketing kits.

Q: Are your branded presentation folders always made with two pockets?

Yes. By default, our pocket folders include both a left and right pocket to securely hold your documents.

Q: Can I add business card slots on both pockets?

Yes. You can add slots to the left pocket, right pocket, or both, making it easier to distribute multiple contacts or departments within a single folder.

Q: How do I print my own design?

Simply upload your custom artwork directly through our online calculator . You can also use our online design tool and free templates to create artwork that's uniquely yours.

Q: How should I set up my pocket folder artwork for correct orientation?

Use the pocket folder template, which shows panel orientation and fold directions. Always review your proof to confirm layout before approval.
